Stress map (capitals = stressed):

1. i NEV-er THOUGHT i'd BE a-LONE (4 stresses)
2. in ALL the EMP-ty ROOMS of this HOUSE (4 stresses)
3. and EV-ery CLOCK is TICK-ing SLOW-er (4 stresses)
4. and NOW that YOU are GONE for GOOD (4 stresses)

By raw syllables you get 8/9/9/8, but raw syllable counts don't measure line length in this method. By stress it reads 4/4/4/4, so the balance is real, not because of the syllable totals.

Line 2 has a greedy-adjacent problem at "this HOUSE": the natural stress wants "THIS house" in speech. Line 3 ends feminine (SLOW-er), which keeps the section open. That serves the unresolved feeling. For a line that scans better, take it to `/songwriting:co-write` line-brainstorm.

Your syllable count doesn't prove balance. By stress the chorus is 4/3/4/4: line 2 is the short one, so the symmetry the 8/9/9/8 count showed isn't there. Whether that unevenness serves the emptiness is your call.
